description:
THREE IDENTITIES IN ONE PAINTING.
Keep Spell I, Spell II, and Spell III as distinct identities — each stays itself (subject, form, palette). They share one scene and interact. Not a triptych, not a 3-panel collage, not one mashed hybrid that erases any identity.
Studio author: Logan Sevin.

MANDATORY PRODUCT PALETTE (override all source colors): Black (#0A0A0C); Green (#16A34A); Yellow (#FACC15); Lime (#84CC16); Purple (#A855F7); Pink (#FF4FA3). Paint with these hex pigments as dominant hues.

THE THREE IDENTITIES (keep each one recognizable):
SPELL I — black Terminal with Green text (#400034)
black Terminal with Green text

SPELL III — Vibrant Green Labrador Portrait (#380)
Vibrant Green Labrador Portrait

A stylized close-up portrait of a yellow Labrador rendered in bold lime green hues.
